/* AppTodoMapper.selectList */
SELECT Z.* , ( SELECT AI_INPT_USER_NM FROM CSPD101TI WHERE AI_INPT_USER_ID = Z.WORKER ) AS WORKER_NM , Z.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AS AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD , CASE WHEN Z.SAVE_FLAG = '00000000000000000000' THEN '' ELSE '저장' END AS SAVE , CASE WHEN Z.SAVE_CHG_DTM = '00000000000000000000' THEN '' ELSE 'start' END AS STARTED
, BIZDS.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM , PRCS.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_PRCSNM , ATVT.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_ATVTNM , TOTRST.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_NM , ITMRST.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_NM , SAFRST.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_NM , CASE WHEN Z.BL IS NULL OR Z.IVOC IS NULL THEN 'NO_BLIV' ELSE 'BLIV' END AS BLIV
FROM ( SELECT A.ACTL_FX_REFNO AS ACTL_FX_REFNO , AI_INSPE_ENO AS WORKER , A.AI_INPT_PROS_CD AS PRCS_CD , A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD AS ATVT_CD , A.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.INPT_MST_SRNO , A.INPT_RCP_DT , A.FX_REFNO_SRNO , A.AI_INPT_IMG_KEY_NO , A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD , A.QLT_GRN_AI_INPT_RST_CD , ( SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN H.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '40' THEN '재추출' WHEN H.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '70' THEN '재심사' ELSE X.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM END) KEEP( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY H.AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO DESC )AS AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD008TH H , CSPD112TI X WHERE H.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND (H.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD IN ('60', '70', '100', '120') OR H.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('40', '70')) AND X.AI_INPT_GRP_CD(+) = '300' AND X.AI_INPT_CMN_CD(+) = H.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD ) AS WRR_INFO
, ( SELECT MAX(FILT_DTCT_NO) KEEP( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO DESC ) AS FILT_DTCT_NO FROM CSPD007TL WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO ) AS FILT_DTCT_NO
, (-- 저장 플래그 SELECT NVL(MAX(LST_DB_CHG_DTM),'00000000000000000000') FROM ( SELECT LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS LST_DB_CHG_DTM --심사처리시작시각 FROM CSPD005TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND AI_INPT_TPY_SAVE_YN = 'Y' AND AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD != '3' ) ) AS SAVE_FLAG
,( SELECT NVL(MAX(LST_DB_CHG_DTM),'00000000000000000000') FROM( SELECT LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS LST_DB_CHG_DTM --심사처리시작시각 FROM CSPD005TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND AI_INPT_TPY_SAVE_YN = 'Y' AND AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD != '3'
UNION ALL
SELECT LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS LST_DB_CHG_DTM --심사처리시작시각 FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO
AND INPT_MST_SRNO IN (SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('100', '130') AND AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD = '51') ) ) AS SAVE_CHG_DTM , NVL(E.XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD, I.TDOC_RCP_CUCD)AS FC_CUNM , NVL(E.XPBY_COL_AM,I.TDOC_RCP_AM) AS AI_INPT_BUY_AM , NVL(E.CUS_KORL_NM,I.CUS_KORL_NM) AS AI_INPT_CUS_NM , NVL(E.CSNO, I.CSNO) AS AI_INPT_CSNO , A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS MST_CHG_DTM ,( SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD002TG WHERE IMEX_HIS_CD = '01' AND INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS BL ,( SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD002TG WHERE IMEX_HIS_CD = '02' AND INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS IVOC FROM CSPD001TM A , CSPD201TM E -- 수출테이블 , CSPD202TM I -- 수입테이블 WHERE A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('100','130') AND A.ACTL_FX_REFNO = E.FX_ACNO(+) AND A.FX_REFNO_SRNO = E.XPO_CVRG_MK_SQ(+) AND A.ACTL_FX_REFNO = I.FX_ACNO(+) AND A.FX_REFNO_SRNO = I.TDOC_RCP_SRNO(+) AND A.AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO = #{userId}
AND A.ACTL_FX_REFNO LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{actlFxRefno}) || '%'
UNION ALL
SELECT A.ACTL_FX_REFNO AS ACTL_FX_REFNO , QLAS_CRPE_ENO AS WORKER , A.AI_INPT_QLAS_PROS_CD AS PRCS_CD , A.AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD AS ATVT_CD , A.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.INPT_MST_SRNO , A.INPT_RCP_DT , A.FX_REFNO_SRNO , A.AI_INPT_IMG_KEY_NO , '3' AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD , A.QLT_GRN_AI_INPT_RST_CD , ( SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN H.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '40' THEN '재추출' WHEN H.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '70' THEN '재심사' ELSE X.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM END) KEEP( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY H.AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO DESC )AS AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD008TH H , CSPD112TI X WHERE H.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND (H.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD IN ('60', '70', '100', '120') OR H.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('40', '70')) AND X.AI_INPT_GRP_CD(+) = '300' AND X.AI_INPT_CMN_CD(+) = H.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD ) AS WRR_INFO , ( SELECT MAX(FILT_DTCT_NO) KEEP( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO DESC ) AS FILT_DTCT_NO FROM CSPD007TL WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO ) AS FILT_DTCT_NO , (-- 저장 플래그 SELECT NVL(MAX(LST_DB_CHG_DTM),'00000000000000000000') FROM ( SELECT LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS LST_DB_CHG_DTM --심사처리시작시각 FROM CSPD005TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND AI_INPT_TPY_SAVE_YN = 'Y' AND AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD = '3' ) ) AS SAVE_FLAG , ( SELECT NVL(MAX(LST_DB_CHG_DTM),'00000000000000000000') FROM( SELECT LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS LST_DB_CHG_DTM --심사처리시작시각 FROM CSPD005TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND AI_INPT_TPY_SAVE_YN = 'Y' AND AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD = '3'
UNION ALL
SELECT LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS LST_DB_CHG_DTM --심사처리시작시각 FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND INPT_MST_SRNO IN (SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('120', '130') AND AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD = '51') ) ) AS SAVE_CHG_DTM , NVL(E.XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD, I.TDOC_RCP_CUCD)AS FC_CUNM , NVL(E.XPBY_COL_AM,I.TDOC_RCP_AM) AS AI_INPT_BUY_AM , NVL(E.CUS_KORL_NM,I.CUS_KORL_NM) AS AI_INPT_CUS_NM , NVL(E.CSNO, I.CSNO) AS AI_INPT_CSNO , A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS MST_CHG_DTM ,( SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD002TG WHERE IMEX_HIS_CD = '01' AND INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO GROUP BY INPT_MST_SRNO ) AS BL ,( SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD002TG WHERE IMEX_HIS_CD = '02' AND INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO GROUP BY INPT_MST_SRNO ) AS IVOC FROM CSPD001TM A , CSPD201TM E -- 수출테이블 , CSPD202TM I -- 수입테이블 WHERE A.AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD IN ('120','130') AND A.ACTL_FX_REFNO = E.FX_ACNO(+) AND A.FX_REFNO_SRNO = E.XPO_CVRG_MK_SQ(+) AND A.ACTL_FX_REFNO = I.FX_ACNO(+) AND A.FX_REFNO_SRNO = I.TDOC_RCP_SRNO(+) AND A.QLAS_SNPE_ENO = #{userId}
AND A.ACTL_FX_REFNO LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{actlFxRefno}) || '%'
)Z
, CSPD112TI BIZDS , CSPD112TI PRCS , CSPD112TI ATVT , CSPD112TI TOTRST , CSPD112TI ITMRST , CSPD112TI SAFRST WHERE 1=1
AND BIZDS.AI_INPT_GRP_CD (+)= '150' AND BIZDS.AI_INPT_CMN_CD (+)= Z.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AND PRCS.AI_INPT_GRP_CD (+)= '280' AND PRCS.AI_INPT_CMN_CD (+)= Z.PRCS_CD AND ATVT.AI_INPT_GRP_CD (+)= '290' AND ATVT.AI_INPT_CMN_CD (+)= Z.ATVT_CD AND TOTRST.AI_INPT_GRP_CD (+)= '170' AND TOTRST.AI_INPT_CMN_CD (+)= Z.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD AND ITMRST.AI_INPT_GRP_CD (+)= '170' AND ITMRST.AI_INPT_CMN_CD (+)= Z.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD AND SAFRST.AI_INPT_GRP_CD (+)= '170' AND SAFRST.AI_INPT_CMN_CD (+)= Z.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD
ORDER BY SAVE
ORDER BY SAVE DESC
ORDER BY INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM
ORDER BY INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM DESC
ORDER BY Z.ACTL_FX_REFNO
ORDER BY Z.ACTL_FX_REFNO DESC
ORDER BY Z.WRR_INFO
ORDER BY Z.WRR_INFO DESC
ORDER BY INPT_PRCSNM
ORDER BY INPT_PRCSNM DESC
ORDER BY INPT_ATVTNM
ORDER BY INPT_ATVTNM DESC
ORDER BY Z.FC_CUNM
ORDER BY Z.FC_CUNM DESC
ORDER BY Z.AI_INPT_CSNO
ORDER BY Z.AI_INPT_CSNO DESC
ORDER BY Z.AI_INPT_BUY_AM
ORDER BY Z.AI_INPT_BUY_AM DESC
ORDER BY Z.AI_INPT_CUS_NM
ORDER BY Z.AI_INPT_CUS_NM DESC
ORDER BY TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_NM
ORDER BY TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_NM DESC
ORDER BY ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_NM
ORDER BY ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_NM DESC
ORDER BY SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_NM
ORDER BY SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_NM DESC
ORDER BY Z.INPT_RCP_DT
ORDER BY Z.INPT_RCP_DT DESC
ORDER BY Z.FILT_DTCT_NO
ORDER BY Z.FILT_DTCT_NO DESC
ORDER BY Z.SAVE_CHG_DTM DESC , Z.MST_CHG_DTM

/* AppTodoMapper.selectListTotCnt */

, ( SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN H.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '40' THEN '재추출' WHEN H.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '70' THEN '재심사' ELSE X.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM END) KEEP( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY H.AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO DESC )AS AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD008TH H , CSPD112TI X WHERE H.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND (H.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD IN ('60', '70', '100', '120') OR H.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('40', '70')) AND X.AI_INPT_GRP_CD(+) = '300' AND X.AI_INPT_CMN_CD(+) = H.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD ) AS WRR_INFO
, ( SELECT MAX(FILT_DTCT_NO) KEEP( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO DESC ) AS FILT_DTCT_NO FROM CSPD007TL WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO ) AS FILT_DTCT_NO
,( SELECT NVL(MAX(LST_DB_CHG_DTM),'00000000000000000000') FROM( SELECT LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS LST_DB_CHG_DTM --심사처리시작시각 FROM CSPD005TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND AI_INPT_TPY_SAVE_YN = 'Y' AND AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD != '3'
UNION ALL
SELECT LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS LST_DB_CHG_DTM --심사처리시작시각 FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO
AND INPT_MST_SRNO IN (SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('100', '130') AND AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD = '51') ) ) AS SAVE_CHG_DTM , NVL(E.XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD, I.TDOC_RCP_CUCD)AS FC_CUNM , NVL(E.XPBY_COL_AM,I.TDOC_RCP_AM) AS AI_INPT_BUY_AM , NVL(E.CUS_KORL_NM,I.CUS_KORL_NM) AS AI_INPT_CUS_NM , NVL(E.CSNO, I.CSNO) AS AI_INPT_CSNO , A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS MST_CHG_DTM FROM CSPD001TM A , CSPD201TM E -- 수출테이블 , CSPD202TM I -- 수입테이블 WHERE A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('100','130') AND A.ACTL_FX_REFNO = E.FX_ACNO(+) AND A.FX_REFNO_SRNO = E.XPO_CVRG_MK_SQ(+) AND A.ACTL_FX_REFNO = I.FX_ACNO(+) AND A.FX_REFNO_SRNO = I.TDOC_RCP_SRNO(+) AND A.AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO = #{userId}
AND A.ACTL_FX_REFNO LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{actlFxRefno}) || '%'
UNION ALL
SELECT A.ACTL_FX_REFNO AS ACTL_FX_REFNO , QLAS_CRPE_ENO AS WORKER , A.AI_INPT_QLAS_PROS_CD AS PRCS_CD , A.AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD AS ATVT_CD , A.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.INPT_MST_SRNO , A.INPT_RCP_DT , A.FX_REFNO_SRNO , A.AI_INPT_IMG_KEY_NO , '3' AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD , ( SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN H.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '40' THEN '재추출' WHEN H.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '70' THEN '재심사' ELSE X.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM END) KEEP( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY H.AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO DESC )AS AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD008TH H , CSPD112TI X WHERE H.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND (H.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD IN ('60', '70', '100', '120') OR H.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('40', '70')) AND X.AI_INPT_GRP_CD(+) = '300' AND X.AI_INPT_CMN_CD(+) = H.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD ) AS WRR_INFO , ( SELECT MAX(FILT_DTCT_NO) KEEP( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO DESC ) AS FILT_DTCT_NO FROM CSPD007TL WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO ) AS FILT_DTCT_NO , ( SELECT NVL(MAX(LST_DB_CHG_DTM),'00000000000000000000') FROM( SELECT LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS LST_DB_CHG_DTM --심사처리시작시각 FROM CSPD005TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND AI_INPT_TPY_SAVE_YN = 'Y' AND AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD = '3'
UNION ALL
SELECT LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS LST_DB_CHG_DTM --심사처리시작시각 FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND INPT_MST_SRNO IN (SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('120', '130') AND AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD = '51') ) ) AS SAVE_CHG_DTM , NVL(E.XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD, I.TDOC_RCP_CUCD)AS FC_CUNM , NVL(E.XPBY_COL_AM,I.TDOC_RCP_AM) AS AI_INPT_BUY_AM , NVL(E.CUS_KORL_NM,I.CUS_KORL_NM) AS AI_INPT_CUS_NM , NVL(E.CSNO, I.CSNO) AS AI_INPT_CSNO , A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS MST_CHG_DTM FROM CSPD001TM A , CSPD201TM E -- 수출테이블 , CSPD202TM I -- 수입테이블 WHERE A.AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD IN ('120','130') AND A.ACTL_FX_REFNO = E.FX_ACNO(+) AND A.FX_REFNO_SRNO = E.XPO_CVRG_MK_SQ(+) AND A.ACTL_FX_REFNO = I.FX_ACNO(+) AND A.FX_REFNO_SRNO = I.TDOC_RCP_SRNO(+) AND A.QLAS_SNPE_ENO = #{userId}
AND A.ACTL_FX_REFNO LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{actlFxRefno}) || '%'
)Z
, CSPD112TI BIZDS , CSPD112TI PRCS , CSPD112TI ATVT , CSPD112TI TOTRST , CSPD112TI ITMRST , CSPD112TI SAFRST WHERE 1=1
AND BIZDS.AI_INPT_GRP_CD (+)= '150' AND BIZDS.AI_INPT_CMN_CD (+)= Z.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AND PRCS.AI_INPT_GRP_CD (+)= '280' AND PRCS.AI_INPT_CMN_CD (+)= Z.PRCS_CD AND ATVT.AI_INPT_GRP_CD (+)= '290' AND ATVT.AI_INPT_CMN_CD (+)= Z.ATVT_CD AND TOTRST.AI_INPT_GRP_CD (+)= '170' AND TOTRST.AI_INPT_CMN_CD (+)= Z.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD AND ITMRST.AI_INPT_GRP_CD (+)= '170' AND ITMRST.AI_INPT_CMN_CD (+)= Z.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD AND SAFRST.AI_INPT_GRP_CD (+)= '170' AND SAFRST.AI_INPT_CMN_CD (+)= Z.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD
